note: Art direction for Heat Wave (HW1). Same family of style as the Starter Box (bold outlines, cel shading, fruit-hooded cats), with an older, cooler tone: cool, not cute.
style: Collectible trading card game illustration in a polished bold cartoon style for teenagers: bold clean outlines, dynamic cel shading, vibrant saturated colours with dramatic warm rim lighting and strong contrast. The characters are cool rather than cute: confident smirks, narrowed determined eyes, athletic dynamic action poses, a low heroic camera angle and a real sense of motion and power. Fire, sparks, glowing embers and smoke as accents. Kid-friendly: no blood, no weapons, nothing gory or scary. One clear main subject, centred and fully in frame, with a painted background scene. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, borders, card frames or watermarks.

families.Pepper: Background: a volcanic canyon at dusk, dark basalt rocks with glowing cracks, embers drifting upwards, a smoky red-orange sky.
families.Garden: Background: a moonlit autumn pumpkin patch at night, glowing jack-o'-lanterns among the vines, drifting silver mist, deep blue and orange light.
families.Tropical: Background: deep space above a tropical planet, a glowing purple and teal nebula, bright stars, a ringed planet in the distance.

heroStyle: A collectible mascot character drawn as a soft plush toy, in a bold flat sticker style: one chunky rounded cat with thick clean black outlines, flat colours and minimal shading. The body is simple with stubby little legs, small paws and a short tail. The cat wears a soft fruit-shaped hood over its head and back, with its two cat ears poking out through the hood. It has attitude: confident narrowed eyes, one eyebrow raised, and a cocky half smile, with no blush on the cheeks. One single character, centred, facing the viewer, whole body in frame with room around it. Toy-like and cool, never realistic, no fur texture, no photo realism, no 3D render. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, borders, card frames or watermarks.

heroFamilies.Pepper: Background: a plain warm backdrop that glows ember orange in the centre and fades to deep red at the edges, with a few simple doodled flames and sparks, so a black cat stands out clearly against it.

subjects.HW1-H01-kitten: Blaze: a small plush kitten mascot with a glossy jet-black body and bright amber eyes, wearing a long curved chili-pepper hood: glossy bright red, shaped like a real chili pepper that runs from a green stem cap on top of its head down its back and tapers to a thin curled pointed tip at its tail, clearly a long chili pepper and not round like a tomato. It sits with a mischievous smirk, holding up one stubby paw with a tiny flame flickering on it like a lighter, a few little embers floating around.
subjects.HW1-H01-bigcat: Blaze: a bigger, bolder plush cat mascot with a glossy jet-black body and glowing amber eyes, wearing a long curved chili-pepper hood: glossy bright red, shaped like a real chili pepper that runs from a green stem cap on top of its head down its back and tapers to a thin curled pointed tip, clearly a long chili pepper and not round like a tomato. It stands in a confident power pose, chest out, stubby fists on its hips, with a ring of cartoon flames swirling around its feet and a cocky grin.
subjects.HW1-P01: A small bat with pale yellow-green pepperoncini-coloured wings shaped like curvy little peppers, hanging upside down from a charred branch, grinning with two tiny cartoon fangs and glowing orange eyes, embers drifting past.
subjects.HW1-P02: A tiny chihuahua with bright chili-red fur and a little curly green stem-shaped tuft on its head, enormous ears, chest puffed out, barking fearlessly at something much bigger off-screen, a small puff of cartoon flame coming from its mouth, standing on a rock.
subjects.HW1-P03: A stocky honey badger with bright glossy jalapeño-green fur and a thick creamy white stripe from its head down its back, a little green pepper-stem tuft on top of its head, walking straight towards the viewer through a low wall of flames, its face clearly visible with a cocky toothy grin and half-lidded unbothered eyes, sparks bouncing off it.
subjects.HW1-P04: A lean wolf with dark green serrano-pepper-coloured fur and bright red pepper-shaped flame markings along its back and legs, standing on a rocky ledge and facing the viewer with a fierce toothy snarl-grin, glowing ember-orange eyes, strong orange rim light outlining its whole body so it stands out, a huge red full moon behind it, sparks swirling up.
subjects.HW1-P05: A burly raccoon with smoky dark red-brown chipotle-coloured fur and a black bandit mask, standing guard with its arms crossed in front of a glowing campfire, wisps of smoke curling around it, tough and unimpressed.
subjects.HW1-P06: A muscular young bull with a glossy orange habanero-coloured hide, head lowered and ready to charge, stamping one hoof, jets of steam and little flames snorting from its nostrils, dust flying.
subjects.HW1-P07: An armoured rhino with a crinkled bright red-orange scotch-bonnet-pepper-textured hide, charging straight at the viewer at full speed, a trail of dust and flames behind it, fierce determined eyes.
subjects.HW1-P08: A large Komodo dragon lizard with deep crimson scales and glowing ember-orange spots, rearing up on its back legs and breathing a big dramatic plume of cartoon fire into the sky, no wings.
subjects.HW1-P09: A bottle of glowing red hot sauce with a flame-shaped blank label, tipping over and splashing dramatically, every drop bursting into a little flame, on a dark rock with sparks flying.
subjects.HW1-P10: Two cats facing off nose to nose in a dusty canyon arena at sunset: a black cat in a chili-red pepper hood and a big grey tabby, both glaring with narrowed eyes, a tumbleweed rolling between them, sparks in the air.
subjects.HW1-P11: A huge ring of roaring flames on a dark canyon floor seen from a low angle, a small brave black cat in a chili-red hood leaping right through the middle of it, sparks spiralling up into the night sky.
subjects.HW1-P12: A chunky black leather collar with rounded blunt silver studs and a small red chili-pepper charm hanging from it, resting on a dark volcanic rock, glowing embers around it, dramatic rim light.
subjects.HW1-P13: Jolokia: a sleek pale ghostly-white cat dressed as a ninja, with a red ghost-pepper-shaped hood mask and a long flowing red scarf, leaping through the air in a spinning kick, a faint translucent ghostly afterimage trailing behind it, no weapons.
subjects.HW1-P14: Ancho: a big muscular dark-brown cat wearing a deep red ancho-chili bandana and boxing hand wraps, standing in a fighting ring with fists raised, confident grin, a small scar over one eyebrow, sparks flying, crowd lights behind.
subjects.HW1-P15: Naga: a huge tiger whose orange fur glows like molten lava, with black stripes and glowing cracks of magma running through its coat, roaring on top of a volcanic rock while lava erupts behind it.
subjects.HW1-X01: Jack: an epic collectible showcase illustration of a fearless cat knight, its cat face fully visible and heroic, with sleek black fur, glowing pumpkin-orange eyes and a confident smirk. It wears ornate dark iron armour trimmed with glowing orange pumpkin-vine filigree, a shoulder guard carved from a pumpkin, and a long tattered midnight-blue cape billowing in the wind. It stands tall on top of a pile of glowing carved jack-o'-lanterns, holding a blazing jack-o'-lantern lantern high above its head that lights up the whole scene. Low heroic camera angle, strong orange backlight and rim light, bats flying across a giant harvest moon. Rich detail, dramatic composition, a card people would frame.
subjects.HW1-X02: Nova: an epic collectible showcase illustration of a daring cat astronaut, its cat face fully visible through an open golden visor, with sleek silver-grey fur, bright determined eyes and a confident grin. It wears a glossy white-and-gold armoured spacesuit with a glowing five-pointed starfruit emblem on its chest, and rockets forward through space in a dynamic flying pose, one paw outstretched holding a blazing golden star, a long comet trail of golden light and sparkles streaming behind it. Dramatic lighting from the star, rich detail, dynamic diagonal composition, a card people would frame.
subjects.HW1-X03-kitten: Reaper: a small plush kitten mascot with a smoky charcoal-grey hairless sphynx body covered in faint glowing orange ember cracks like cooling lava, big pointed ears, wearing a deep glossy crimson wrinkled Carolina Reaper pepper hood with a curled pointed tail at the back like a scorpion's. It sits with a sly half-lidded smirk and glowing ember-orange eyes, a small flame dancing on the tip of its tail.
subjects.HW1-X03-bigcat: Reaper: a bigger, imposing plush cat mascot with a smoky charcoal-grey hairless sphynx body covered in glowing orange ember cracks like cooling lava, big pointed ears, wearing a deep glossy crimson wrinkled Carolina Reaper pepper hood with a curled pointed scorpion-like tail and a flowing crimson cape with ember-lit edges. It stands tall with its stubby arms crossed and glowing ember-orange eyes, a cool confident smirk, surrounded by a swirling ring of flames and heat shimmer.
